verdict.rationale: Kong documents decK as a CLI for API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps) that orchestrates and automates gateway configuration. It also supports declarative DB-less deployment, with routing, load balancing and health checks configurable via declarative config, and kongctl is a further management tool. The core of managing API infrastructure as declarative config is clearly delivered, but syncing from CI is only implied by the APIOps/automation framing, not shown concretely. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline/GitOps sync workflow documentation (e.g. diff/sync in CI, drift detection), independent or hands-on corroboration.
